title: Chapter 1055
paragraphs: Chapter 1055
Episode 251. The Great Adversaries (5)
Jin felt like he had been hit on the head.
Valeria was right. If his regression was the only secret unknown to Ziffle, it must never be revealed.
"Jin, you understand what I said, right?"
"I get it."
"Has anyone ever suspected your secret in your life?"
Yes, there were a few.

When Jin killed Kidard Hall, he mentioned that it took '44 years' for his revenge, and Ron, after ascending to Genesis, realized Jin's regression when he became the light of the Sword Emperor. Ayulra also recognized it just before she vanished.
And Kelliark, having heard the keyword '44 years' from Kidard Hall, had once suspected Jin.
Without mentioning regression or the '44 years', Jin explained these details to Valeria.

"Then the only ones who definitely knew are Sir Ron and Lady Ayulra. That's a relief. If the Demon Lords are analyzing this world with completed Origin Stones, then your secret hasn't been clearly revealed yet. Most importantly, it seems like a pre-branching point situation…"
"Branching point?"

"Heluram is the most powerful immortal, but only recently did she realize the truth of the multiverse and meet Orgal. I think the reason for this is a branching point. The world must reach a certain branching point to access such information, especially for beings of high divinity."
Valeria's hypothesis about the branching point was as follows:
First, the case when other dimensions began to interfere with this world.
Second, when the history of the world reached a certain segment.
Third, when a Hister from another dimension deliberately transmitted information to this dimension at a specific segment.

"All three are possibilities. Anyway, a special condition must be needed for someone to recognize the multiverse, which is why Heluram, who was a bystander, has only just started to act. And the moments when your secret could have been revealed or was close to being revealed were all before Heluram recognized the multiverse. So, my guess is it won’t be easy for the Demon Lords to discover that information. It would be before their interference."
Of course, it was all hypothetical, but being cautious couldn’t hurt.
Excluding this hypothesis, there was no reason not to reveal his regression, but there was also no pressing need to do so.
"I hope father reveals the secret of Solderet soon."
"I'm curious too. If Orgal's words are true, there seems to be some connection between Solderet and me, but I can't quite grasp it yet."
"Let's wait and see. Anyway, thanks, I almost made a mistake."
At that, Valeria smiled.
"Then, spare a moment to have tea with me here. Let's drink and then get back to work."
"Sounds good."
While making tea, Jin felt as if he had returned to the old days. It was like the time before his regression when he traveled with Valeria as her teacher and student.
"Kid, what the hell are you doing…"
The next morning.
Murakan glared at Jin with narrow eyes.
"Why?"
"Why? You're asking why? You were with the history nerd all night until now... just the two of you, in an enclosed space!"
"So what?"
"So what? Ha! Let me explain. I've never spent such time with Strawberry Pie because of you. What did you do!?"
"We drank tea."
"You spent all that time just drinking tea? You didn't even hold hands, did you!?"
Jin shrugged as if it wasn't worth answering.

"Ah, what... Be quiet and take care of Tikan. I'm going to meet friends in the Demonic Realm. Once the Golden Fleet is completed and the Tower of Story tracking begins, there'll be no time at all, so go ahead and ask Gilli out on a date."
"What!? A date!?"
"And I never gave you a hint. Your approach is the problem... If you get rejected this time, give up on being lovers with Strawberry Pie, no, with Gilli."
With that, Murakan went to Gilli's room. She was just getting up and about to tidy her room.
"Strawberry Pie!"
"Murakan?"
"Do you have time today!?"
"Time? Why are you asking all of a sudden..."
Murakan thought Gilli looked prettier than usual that day, then suddenly remembered his own excited and enthusiastic demeanor, which probably wasn't a pretty sight.
"Just wait a moment. This doesn't seem right. I'll come back."
"What?"
Turning around, Murakan thought:
Who in Tikan dresses the most stylishly and exudes grace in their actions? Murakan was briefly lost in thought.
It was Hedo, whom Murakan usually referred to as the embodiment of physical beauty. In a hurry, Murakan flew to Hedo's room instead of taking the stairs.
"Physical Beauty!"
"Murakan. People usually use the door to visit, not the window."
"Open it up!"
In Hedo's room, Sandra and Veil were together. Fortunately, Sandra was unaware that Jin and Valeria had spent the night together. The colleagues at Tikan would never tell Sandra about it.
"What brings you here?"
"I need to borrow some clothes."
"...You said clothes?"
"Yes, I'm planning to ask Gilli out on a date. It seems I can't go about it as usual. Wait, do I have to explain this to you?"
Hedo quickly understood and nodded.

He then slowly scrutinized Murakan from head to toe. While his wild charm was evident, his long hair was unruly, his black coat was dusty, and his shirt, likely to be undone soon, was missing a few buttons.
Sandra and Veil showed immediate interest, their eyes twinkling.

"Wow, Murakan is finally becoming a man. Paying attention to such things? But Murakan, if Gilli likes you, she'll find you attractive no matter how you look. I would still love Jin even if he turned into a meatloaf. Right, Veil?"
"Not right... crazy, a meatloaf? Are you sane?"
"What's wrong with that?"
"You're right, it's not right. Ignore what the lady says. Hmm... Given the urgency, just leave it to me."
"Okay, okay, make me look good."
Click, click!
As Murakan sat down, Hedo quickly and skillfully prepared for styling.
"First, let's comb your hair properly. This hair oil is something I treasure, but I'll let you use it this time."
"I once secretly used that oil and almost got bent over by Hedo." (nah, it’s not what u think)

"For the shirt... let's go with this simple one. What? No tiger prints? This is a costume I collected for theater actors... it's not for everyday wear. My clothes won't fit you, but luckily I have a few I made for Jin. No need for a coat in this season. The shoes seem to fit well enough."
"If the size doesn't fit, just use transformation to adjust it."
"Great. Try these on. Make sure to button up the shirt completely. Don't leave it open as usual, that's it. And don't pop the collar. I said not to. Lady, please

turn around for a moment. He needs to put on his pants... Wait, why are your underwear so flashy... Well, it might not be bad. No, why are you throwing away the belt? Fit it properly. Don't loosen it if you feel full."
After getting dressed, Murakan twisted his body around uncomfortably for a while. Hedo finally sprayed a cool yet intense perfume and turned the full-body mirror to show Murakan's reflection.
Sharply combed hair, a neat navy blue shirt, ivory pants, and rounded-toe shoes. It was an unfamiliar feeling.
Murakan looked at Hedo, half in disbelief.
"Are you sure this looks okay?"
"Even Misha would compliment you."
"It's your fault if it goes wrong."

"Let go of such negative thoughts. Go and speak calmly. As the Alliance will soon become busy, I really want to spend time with you. Let's have a fancy meal together and catch up. By the way, these are the best restaurants and pubs in Tikan."
"Alright... I'm going."
As Murakan dashed away, Sandra and Veil shrugged in disappointment.
"Wasn't that line a bit weak?"
"What does the line matter, miss. Gilli already likes Mr. Murakan."
"Gilli likes Murakan?"
"It's surprising that an immortal didn't know that."
"Actually, it wouldn't have been a problem even if he went straight there."
Standing in front of Gilli's room again, Murakan took a deep breath.
Knock, knock.
"Strawberry Pie, it's me."
Gilli opened the door and gasped upon seeing him.
"You changed clothes...?"
"Ah, that. Um, does it look strange?"
Murakan immediately regretted asking that.
"No, it suits you very well. But why are you here?"
Gilli regretted her response as soon as she said it.
A moment of silence ensued. Both were unable to look each other in the eyes, feeling awkward and hot as if they were sweating.
"So, the reason I came is..."
Murakan recalled the words Hedo gave him. Before it gets busy, I really want to spend time with you, let's have a fancy meal and talk...
But just as he was about to speak, he felt it wasn't right to say that. It seemed he needed to say something else.
"I came here because I love you, Strawberry Pie."
Eeeek! Huh!
The sound came not from Gilli, but from the colleagues, including Hedo, who were peeking from behind the corridor wall.
Gilli blinked her wide eyes, staring at Murakan. And the next moment, as Murakan's brain temporarily froze, he blurted out the following words.
"So, let's go for a meal and spend some wonderful time talking..."
